project.job: Bromfelde Corner, 25 Bromfelde Road, London SW4 6PP
project.model_title: ES26-087 Bromfelde Corner, 25 Bromfelde Road, London SW4 6PP - Quotation

views.title: Foundation and ground floor
views.desc: The 6in XR35 / 6in Std foundation (2 courses on a strip footing, by others) and the precast beam and block ground floor with 150 insulation and 50 screed (top of screed = FFL = top of the foundation course).

views.title: Ground floor walls, windows and partitions
views.desc: Ground-floor walls (6 courses): 6in XR35 external walls with the three front bays (as drawn, 3:4 mitred sides), the 6in Std stair core and flat separating wall; windows, the garden doors and the entrance; timber stud partitions.

views.title: First floor
views.desc: Precast beam and block first floor (100 topping + 25 screed) with the indicative steels (engineer) and the roof terrace over Flat 2; first-floor walls, bays, windows, terrace doors and partitions; the four bays capped with shallow (20 degree) hipped slate roofs under the second-floor sills.

views.title: Second floor
views.desc: Second floor (precast beam and block), the second-floor walls over the main block, windows, terrace doors and partitions; the two-storey wing is roofed at this level.

views.title: Third floor (attic) and the party wall
views.desc: Third-floor (Flat 5 attic) precast floor, the eaves walls and the NE party wall against 27 Bromfelde Road carried up and raked to 50 mm below the top of the rafters.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Cut roofs (indicative - engineer): the main hipped roof with a gable against the NE party wall (33 degrees, natural slate) and the hipped roof over the two-storey wing. C24 rafters @600.
